decision_context.selection_rationale: Internal product clients need flexible aggregation over multiple domain entities with schema-governed evolution.
decision_context.naming_convention_summary: GraphQL types use PascalCase, fields and args use camelCase, and mutation names are domain-intent based.
decision_context.threshold_method_summary: Complexity and resolver latency limits are derived from p95 SLO budget and datastore fan-out constraints.

threshold_policy.latency_target_derivation: Set p95 resolver latency target from end-user interaction budget for aggregation-heavy screens.
threshold_policy.availability_target_derivation: Set availability by product criticality and internal error-budget allocation.
threshold_policy.timeout_budget_derivation: Distribute timeout budget across gateway, resolver execution, and backend dependencies.
threshold_policy.capacity_headroom_derivation: Set headroom from peak query complexity distribution and release-event traffic spikes.
threshold_policy.payload_limit_derivation: Bound response size from client rendering cost and network transfer budget.
threshold_policy.concurrency_limit_derivation: Set concurrent query limits from GraphQL gateway worker utilization targets.
threshold_policy.retry_backoff_derivation: Retry budget is constrained by mutation idempotency and downstream contention risk.
threshold_policy.delivery_semantics_derivation: Read and mutation semantics are defined per field, including nullability and partial failure handling.
